exam.title: Microsoft Power Platform Developer
exam.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Power Platform development across Dataverse, canvas and model-driven apps, Power Automate and solutions, plus practical Power Fx, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, JSON, OpenAPI, REST/OData, Azure Functions, identity, security, ALM, testing and troubleshooting experience.

review.notes: Every March 19, 2026 subobjective is mapped to an extension choice, data/identity/security/transaction boundary, lifecycle control, implementation contract, evidence, failure, or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight independent labs and 36 original checks cover out-of-box versus code, standard/virtual/elastic tables, preview Power Fx functions, DLP and Dataverse security, solutions/layers/dependencies/environment variables/connections, pipelines and Build Tools, Power Fx/delegation/Monitor, Client API/commands/custom pages, PCF lifecycle, plug-in pipeline/context/images/Organization service/custom APIs/business events, OpenAPI connectors/policies/code, Web API/SDK/OAuth/limits/bulk, Functions/managed identity, flows/Key Vault/child flows/service principals, webhooks/Service Bus/Event Hubs, change tracking/alternate keys/Upsert and reconciliation. All 19 URLs are cataloged: 18 reachable and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records an active credential, stale pre-update notice on the credential page, about 25 hours of current Learn paths, five-day course, MIT official labs, free Practice Assessment, current commercial and public-video choices, and freshness caveats for 2022–2024 material. September 17 catalog maintenance added the official AB-400 replacement-blueprint link (HTTP 200) and the October transition notice. Link evidence now includes that additional source; the September 1 technical review date, PL-400 objective mapping, and snapshot hash remain unchanged. AB-400 coverage is pending.

findings.title: Live URL contains replacement objectives
findings.evidence: The live PL-400 and AB-400 pages publish October 16 scope while March remains the accepted PL-400 baseline.
findings.recommendation: Map future objectives and add a separate replacement-scope section; preserve snapshots.
findings.resolution: Map future objectives and add a separate replacement-scope section; preserve snapshots.

findings.title: Personal pipelines cannot be extended
findings.evidence: Linked platform-host guide explicitly limits personal pipelines and directs advanced requirements to custom hosts.
findings.recommendation: Correct generic extension claim and host-association cleanup boundary.
findings.resolution: Correct generic extension claim and host-association cleanup boundary.

findings.title: Connector import and OAuth support are route specific
findings.evidence: The documented import route requires OpenAPI 2.0 below 1 MB and does not support OAuth client credentials in its security definition.
findings.recommendation: State import/auth boundary separately from service-principal Dataverse connector support.
findings.resolution: State import/auth boundary separately from service-principal Dataverse connector support.

findings.title: A filtering attribute need not have changed
findings.evidence: Update filtering checks attribute presence; comparing images is needed for value-change side effects.

findings.title: Fresh full sync does not supply historical deletes
findings.evidence: Initial synchronization returns current records; configured change retention and unsupported query options constrain incremental replay.
findings.recommendation: Add stale-replica worked example and checkpoint/scope guidance.
findings.resolution: Add stale-replica worked example and checkpoint/scope guidance.

findings.title: Elastic Upsert bypasses separate Create/Update events
findings.evidence: Elastic and standard tables have different event and payload behavior.
findings.recommendation: Teach Upsert-path validation and update-only versus optimistic-concurrency semantics.
findings.resolution: Teach Upsert-path validation and update-only versus optimistic-concurrency semantics.

findings.title: New setup recommends federation version 2
findings.evidence: Current guidance hashes full certificate distinguished names and requires identity record/binding plus resource authorization.
findings.recommendation: Separate plug-in outbound identity from Function inbound Dataverse access.
findings.resolution: Separate plug-in outbound identity from Function inbound Dataverse access.

findings.title: Background processing does not extend plug-in timeout
findings.evidence: Preview custom-API background requests retain two-minute execution and cancel does not interrupt a running operation.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit timeout, status and cancellation boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add explicit timeout, status and cancellation boundaries.

findings.title: Removing a directive differs from deny all
findings.evidence: Empty custom source lists can omit a directive; reporting differs from enforcement and API updates replace the collection.
findings.recommendation: Add CSP worked example with fallback and preservation checks.
findings.resolution: Add CSP worked example with fallback and preservation checks.

findings.title: Publishing principal needs existing app edit access
findings.evidence: Environment access is insufficient; a maker shares the app using the Enterprise Application object ID.
findings.recommendation: Add publication grant boundary in code-app ALM preparation.
findings.resolution: Add publication grant boundary in code-app ALM preparation.

findings.title: Client library has a harness-specific boundary
findings.evidence: Current client library guidance supports standard-harness Studio agents, not GitHub Copilot harness agents.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate client library from connector and MCP/A2A routes.
findings.resolution: Differentiate client library from connector and MCP/A2A routes.
